ns2:section.sectionText: This course involves asynchronous and synchronous components. For the asynchronous component, video lectures and other online activities would be provided at the beginning of every week on the Moodle website of this course. The synchronous component will be conducted over Zoom every Thursday from 12:30pm to 1:50 pm. Restricted to Sociology Major, Sociology Minor or Criminology, Law, and Society Minor during advanced enrollment. Remaining seats will become available during open registration.
